sourceTitle: German Dark Chocolate Drink with Xocai Healthy Chocolate
sourceText:
German Dark Chocolate Drink with Xocai Healthy Chocolate
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Friday, September 21, 2012 - 3:02pm

Ingredients




5 cubes ice
1/2 oz kahlua
1/4 oz creme de cacao
1/4 oz frangelico
1 chunk dark chocolate (Xocai X Power Square)
1 dash heavy cream

Preparation

1 Add ingredients to rock glass in the order listed. Optional: Garnish with Orange Peel and/or slivered Xocai X Power Square. Serves 1
